# MeshDecimator

Sources from https://github.com/Whinarn/MeshDecimator (master, downloaded 2026-10-11).
MIT license, copyright Mattias Edlund, original algorithm Sven Forstmann.
Original C# sources are unchanged; the SDK project file is local.
The upstream lossless threshold is not treated as a guarantee of unchanged geometry.
Automatic simplification is restricted and validated by SwMultiExport's wrapper.
